decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using aggressive Rakdos creatures like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord helps to pump up your creatures and provide additional value. The deck also includes some card draw with Dusk Legion Zealot and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to maintain a steady stream of threats. The inclusion of Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet provides additional board presence and graveyard hate. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a heavy emphasis on black and red cards. It utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper to put pressure on opponents early in the game. Cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat help control the board while Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional support and buffs to your creatures. Thoughtseize and Duress disrupt opponents' strategies while Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provide late-game power. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The deck focuses on using green mana and creature devotion to power up big threats quickly and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Key cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Leyline of the Guildpact help ramp up mana production and make big plays early on. The strategy is to establish board presence quickly with powerful creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns, while also utilizing cards like Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan to keep pressure on the opponent. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional threats and resilience to removal spells.

The deck focuses on resource denial and card advantage through counterspells, removal, and card draw. It aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy, protecting its own threats, and generating incremental advantage over time. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides an additional threat and synergizes with the deck's control elements. With a mix of permission spells, removal, and powerful finishers like Narset and Supreme Verdict, the deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in a grindy game of attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble a combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre along with card draw and life gain support to achieve victory. The deck utilizes cards like Extraction Specialist and Chord of Calling to search for key pieces, while also leveraging cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper to gain life and provide additional value. Collected Company is used to help find combo pieces quickly, while Aetherflux Reservoir serves as a finisher once the combo is assembled. The deck aims to efficiently execute its combo while maintaining board presence and life total.

This deck aims to assemble a powerful combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Aetherflux Reservoir, and various creatures that gain life or generate mana. The strategy revolves around casting Collected Company and Chord of Calling to find key pieces, while utilizing cards like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper to gain life and ramp up mana. By gaining a large amount of life and casting spells, the deck can use Aetherflux Reservoir to deal lethal damage to the opponent in one turn. The deck also includes some removal and protection spells to help ensure the combo can be executed successfully.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with spells, in order to bring Arclight Phoenix back from the graveyard multiple times in a game. This deck aims to be fast-paced and aggressive, utilizing cards like Consider, Opt, and Sleight of Hand to dig for more spells, while also having removal like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion offers an additional mana source and a consistent creature to help push damage through.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up green mana devotion through ramp creatures like Llanowar Elves and Old-Growth Troll, allowing for powerful plays with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck aims to flood the board with green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Ulvenwald Oddity, supported by card draw and mana fixing from Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Boseiju, Who Endures adds additional utility and protection to the strategy.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Aetherflux Reservoir, and various creatures like Cenote Scout and Prosperous Innkeeper to generate enough life gain to enable a massive Aetherflux Reservoir activation. The deck also includes cards like Chord of Calling, Collected Company, and Return to the Ranks to help find the necessary combo pieces quickly. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and finish off the opponent with a huge blast of life gain from Aetherflux Reservoir.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a Rakdos color combination, utilizing powerful creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. Cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Vein Ripper, and Archfiend of the Dross provide strong threats on the board, while Fatal Push and Go for the Throat help deal with opposing creatures. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help provide additional synergy and card advantage. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board control throughout the game to secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse adds a strong late-game potential to finish off opponents. Cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize help control the opponent's board and disrupt their strategy, while powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provide additional support and utility. The deck aims to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy while also having options for disruption and control.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to turn Atraxa or Mirrex into game-winning creatures, such as Blightstep Pathway or Case of the Stashed Skeleton. The deck includes a mix of removal spells, hand disruption, and additional threats to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their strategy. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion for additional mana acceleration.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to establish board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy using counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Memory Deluge. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently answering threats and generating card advantage over time. The inclusion of the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides an additional card advantage engine and a powerful creature option. The deck also features utility lands and spell lands to further enhance its control game plan.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal, and card draw to outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Dovin's Veto and Supreme Verdict while generating card advantage with Narset, Parter of Veils and Memory Deluge. The deck also includes win conditions like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon to close out the game. The mana base is tailored to support the control strategy by providing the necessary colors and utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Vantress.

This Azorius Tempo/Spirit Aggro deck focuses on being aggressive and controlling the tempo of the game with cards like Mausoleum Wanderer, Spell Queller, and Supreme Phantom. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent with counterspells like Lofty Denial and removal spells like Skyclave Apparition, while also benefiting from Spirit synergies and flying creatures. By maintaining a balance between aggression and disruption, the deck looks to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through efficient play and strategic decision-making.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively get Arclight Phoenix onto the battlefield through efficient card draw, spells, and mana acceleration. By utilizing low-cost spells and cantrips like Sleight of Hand and Opt, along with removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse, the deck aims to clear the way for Arclight Phoenix to deal damage and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder also adds disruptive elements to the deck, allowing for versatility in both offense and defense.
